title: Adaptive deployment path for customer-submitted model variants with shadow stability probe
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers frequently request adding customer-provided model variants or pinning older versions for compatibility. Current catalog onboarding paths are either too heavyweight (full eval + compliance lane) or too permissive (ad-hoc fastpath) and lack a focused way to safely surface customer models for validation.

This ticket defines an adaptive, sponsorless onboarding lane for customer-submitted model variants that combines a short automated eval, a time-limited shadow stability probe, and a lightweight pin policy. The goal is to reduce time-to-availability for customer-requested models while limiting production risk and ensuring we gather the telemetry needed to make pin/deprecation decisions.

Scope: define gating logic, telemetry requirements, rollout/auto-revert policies, Console UI affordances for pin requests, and acceptance criteria for moving a model from shadow probe -> pinned -> full catalog. Coordinate with Eng for runtime compatibility checks (KV cache, quantization), Design for Console flows, and Security for KMS/audit log constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Definition of automated eval suite (baseline sketches, hallucination check, latency/percentile thresholds) for shadow probe entry
Shadow stability probe plan: percentage routing (configurable default 0.5% -> 1%), minimum observation window (7 days), auto-revert trigger rules documented
Pinning policy drafted: allowable pin durations, renewal flow, cost attribution directions for customer vs org
Console mockups for sponsorless pin request and probe status indicators reviewed by Design
Telemetry dashboard (catalog-probe) wireup tasks created in ENG backlog and initial queries defined
Security signoff on audit logging and KMS usage for any customer model artifacts
comments: 2025-11-06 - Aisha Patel: Draft PRD uploaded to Confluence (see links). Goal is to unblock enterprise customer pilot without requiring a sponsor or full legal review for every variant.

2025-11-12 - Miguel Ortega: Engineering spike to validate runtime compatibility for customer-supplied quantized models completed. Key finding: KV cache warmup still works but requires a model metadata flag; ENG spike notes attached: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123
2025-12-02 - Design review (Desi Kumar): Console flow needs a clear 'probe' state and tooltip copy to explain risk & SLA implications. Filed DES-1102 for UI work.

2026-01-15 - Eng lead (Liu Chen): Suggested adding a staged metric bundle: latency_p95, token_cost_delta, hallucination_rate (human-labeled sample), and drift_score. Agreed to prioritize latency and hallucination for initial gate.

2026-02-01 - Security (R. Gomes): Raised KMS key ownership question for customer-provided models in Private deployments. Decision: require customer-managed KMS for private/on-prem; hosted customers must consent to Redwood-managed KMS with explicit audit events.

2026-02-20 - PM sync: Decided shadow probe defaults to 1% routing for 7 days with ability to extend to 21 days. Auto-revert triggers: hallucination_rate increase > 3x baseline OR latency_p95 increase > 25% OR error_rate spike > 2x baseline. These thresholds are draft and will be tuned on pilot.
2026-03-02 - Miguel Ortega: Created ENG-20450 to implement probe telemetry and routing flags. Initial telemetry queries and dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/cat123/catalog-probe-overview
2026-03-08 - Aisha Patel: Legal requested copy template for the customer consent modal. Filed PM-987655 to track consent text localization and audit traceability.
2026-03-10 - Review: Stakeholders approved move to pilot for two customer models. Next: run pilot, collect 7-day telemetry, score against acceptance criteria, and prepare pinning cadence playbook.
decision_log: Use a sponsorless probe for low-friction onboarding to support enterprise customers that need quick access to older or custom model variants.
Default probe parameters: 1% traffic, 7-day window, auto-revert rules specified in comments.
Require explicit telemetry bundle before allowing pin beyond 30 days: latency_p95, hallucination_rate, token_cost_delta, error_rate.
Hosted vs Private KMS handling: hosted accepts Redwood-managed KMS with recorded consent; private requires customer-managed KMS.
